matrix.independent_variable: A = age of generator operating state telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Uncredited generator offline trip duration and unsupplied energy credit (kWh)
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of measured high-frequency SCADA breaker trip timestamps and hardware-in-the-loop generator test rig.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of active power telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Integrated energy estimation discrepancy over 6h horizon (kWh) and active power error (kW)
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of real high-resolution time-series active power step-load logs for Nuolja gensets.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of ambient temperature and intake differential pressure telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Capacity overestimation error (kW) and infeasible generator dispatch assignment
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of polar blizzard intake air restriction physical test data and ambient thermal derate logs.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of fuel tank level telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Fuel volume estimation error (Liters) and premature generator starvation duration (hours)
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of sub-zero day-tank fuel slosh, level sensor response, and leak rate time-series logs.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of mass/volumetric fuel flow telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: BSFC deviation from baseline model and accelerated fuel depletion rate (L/h)
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of low-temperature polar fuel viscosity calibration and Coriolis flowmeter logs.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of block temperature and starter battery telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Startability misclassification error rate and unstartable generator safety credit (kWh)
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of sub-zero block heater failure thermal decay measurements and cold-cranking trials.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of ECU CAN-bus health and fault telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Unreported active fault duration (seconds) and trip-on-command generator commitment error
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of ECU J1939 fault injection logs and SCADA-to-CAN gateway communication latency recordings.

matrix.independent_variable: A = age of hardwired LOTO key switch and aux contact telemetry (seconds)
matrix.consequence_metric: Safety interlock violation duration and invalid safety-credit authorization
matrix.blocker_reason: Absence of physical contact bounce and SCADA hardwired interlock latency logs at Nuolja station.
